verdict.rationale: Unleash's first-party docs say the Admin API gives full programmatic access to manage all resources, naming feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations, which directly addresses API/UI parity. An official MCP server for creating and managing flags adds another programmatic path. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that every UI action has an API equivalent, endpoint-level documentation depth in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
The Admin API provides comprehensive programmatic access to all Unleash resources.
This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.
